_comment: Project manifest (U-28) — makes the project's strategic GOALS and lifecycle PHASES configuration-driven instead of hardcoded in the engine. Consumed via autopilot/lib/manifest-loader.mjs, which validates this file, falls back to built-in defaults if it is missing/malformed, and exposes { projectName, description, goals, phases, appId } + a goalPriority() helper that the candidate-ranking layer (lib/score.mjs) uses to prioritize tasks. Onboarding a new project = edit this file only. goals[].priority MUST mirror config.json → scoring.categoryBonus so there is no ranking regression.
description: Gamified real-time team-management app powering the 'Race to Tzion' adventure event in Jerusalem.
